answer_1.quote: We propose a new metric aimed at measuring semantic diversity by leveraging a Natural Language Inference (NLI) model to score a set of multiple dialogue model responses for a single conversation.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate three diversity metrics: Baseline NLI Diversity, Sent-BERT, and distinct‑n. We also use two established relevancy metrics: BLEU Score and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Each set of responses in conTest and decTest is scored by 10 annotators from 1 (not diverse at all) to 5 (very diverse) with half‑point increments.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate the diversity of a set of responses on a Likert scale from 1 (not diverse at all) to 5 (very diverse).
